About the Scholarship

MESPOM is the Erasmus Mundus master in environmental sciences, policy and management run by Central European University with Lund, Manchester and the University of the Aegean. For studies in 2027-2029, applications for financial aid and visa-sensitive applicants close on 7 January 2027, with later self-funded rounds on the admissions calendar.

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

MESPOM is the Erasmus Mundus master in environmental sciences, policy and management run by Central European University with Lund, Manchester and the University of the Aegean. For studies in 2027-2029, applications for financial aid and visa-sensitive applicants close on 7 January 2027, with later self-funded rounds on the admissions calendar.

Programme Highlights

  • Four-university consortium spanning Austria, Sweden, the UK and Greece
  • 7 January 2027 deadline for financial-aid and visa-sensitive applicants
  • Strong blend of natural science, policy analysis and management training
  • Alumni across UNEP-type agencies, consultancies and doctoral programmes

Who Should Apply

Graduates in environmental and natural sciences, engineering, economics and policy with a sustainability interest are the core applicants.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus support for eligible applicants in the main round; self-funded routes run later in the spring.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the MESPOM portal and check the deadlines-and-calendar page for the round that matches your funding and visa situation. Key deadline information: 7 January 2027 (financial aid / visa-sensitive applicants); further self-funded rounds per the admissions calendar.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About MESPOM Consortium (Central European University)

The MESPOM consortium is coordinated by Central European University and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Environmental Sciences, Policy and Management with Lund, Manchester and the University of the Aegean.

Official website: https://mespom.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 7 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
